changes.title: Frostwyrm
items: A new creature for the mountains and glaciers: the frost wyrm, a wingless ice dragon with great swept-back horns, and its own area, the Frost cave: glacier ice, frozen falls, stunted firs and crystal-leaf trees
Its legend is the elder of all wyrms: aeons old, scarred, one horn broken, an icicle beard, its hoard frozen into its belly. It gives Wyrm's Glide: a longer blink

changes.title: Elephant
items: A new creature for the jungle west: the elephant, the biggest animal in the forest, with a trunk, great fan ears and tusks
Its legend is the elder of the elephants, an ancient matriarch, her trunk raised, her tusks banded in bronze, hung with temple bells, a jewelled brow-cloth and a garland of flowers
Its own area, the Temple jungle: strangler figs and kapoks over red earth, and a heap of tumbled temple stones in the clearing
The elephant's legend gives Elephant's Trumpet: bigger 💌s that carry further

changes.title: Tiger
items: A new creature for the jungle west: the tiger, a long, low, striped cat; its legend is the elder of the tigers, huge and scarred, its ruff gone white, hung with a garland of offerings
Its own area, the Bamboo jungle: dense bamboo groves under tall kapoks and strangler figs, and a heap of mossed temple rubble in the clearing
The tiger's legend, asleep under the ferns, gives Tiger's Pounce: a longer blink, and quicker off the mark
